description_en: Calls the RescaleApplication operation to asynchronously scale resources in or out and complete container deployment or release operations
description_zh: 调用RescaleApplication异步执行资源扩/缩容，并完成容器部署/释放操作
name: RescaleApplication

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can obtain this value by calling the ListApplications operation
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，您可通过查询ListApplications接口获取
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The scaling action for resources. Valid values:
Add: Provisions new resources.
Del: Releases resources
parameters.help_zh:
扩缩容资源动作。枚举类型，取值：
Add：生产新资源。
Del：释放资源
parameters.name: rescale_type

parameters.help_en:
The level of the scaling region. Valid values:

AreaIspCode: region ISP.
RegionId: edge zone.
InstanceId: instance. Scale-out indicates resource hosting. Scale-in indicates resource release.

Default value: AreaIspCode
parameters.help_zh:
扩缩容区域级别。枚举类型，取值范围：

AreaIspCode：区域运营商
RegionId：边缘节点
InstanceId：实例，扩容代表资源托管 / 缩容代表资源释放

默认值AreaIspCode
parameters.name: rescale_level

parameters.help_en: The scaling resource requirements. The value is a string in JSON array format
parameters.help_zh: 扩缩容资源需求，Json数组格式的字符串
parameters.name: resource_selector

parameters.help_en: The application deployment version for new resources. This parameter takes effect only when resources are added. Default value: the stable version number of the application
parameters.help_zh: 仅新增资源时有效，新增资源的应用部署版本号，默认为应用的稳定版版本号
parameters.name: to_app_version

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for asynchronous scaling, in seconds. Default value: 300
parameters.help_zh: 异步扩缩容的超时时间，单位秒。默认300
parameters.name: timeout
